description: Add a trigger that starts the agent with these instructions: event (event_type such as lead.created, with an optional source), schedule (a schedule object) or watch. Each start is a run under the agent's permissions and uses agent credits. Its approval rules stay as set in Fine Structure, and a webhook trigger, whose URL is a secret, is made on the agent's screen.

schedule.description: For trigger_type schedule or watch: the same shape as in schedule_agent_task, e.g. {"type":"daily","time":"08:30","timezone":"Asia/Jerusalem"}.

name: create_agent_trigger
